item: Settings > Advanced > Maintenance: the qualification dry run and two reports without curl (R196)
refs: PR #1503; R196; audit 0.5.0 follow-on; browser walk is 0.5.1 item 19
key_paths: src/static/app-maintenance.js src/static/index.html src/static/app-shell.js tests/maintenance_node_test.js tests/test_maintenance_panel.py docs/QUALIFICATION.md
summary: A Maintenance section under Settings > Advanced starts the quarantine dry run (optionally with stub pages and the host comparison), shows the live state, the tally, the per-signal samples and both reports (bare-identifier source names, repeated lines in one source). It uses only the existing /api/quarantine routes and makes no request off this computer. DRY RUN ONLY: the one start URL spells write=false and nothing in the panel can change that (pinned by source). Counts read as candidates under rules fitted to few specimens, the caveat visible; site could not be read is its own row and never a mismatch; a signal the run did not ask for reads not measured, never zero; a sample title opens the local reader and the stored URL is plain text, no outbound link. The poll runs only while a run is live and the section is open, and reopening the section re-reads. A paused run that has writing on is not resumable from the panel (resume keeps the run own mode), and a tally says a rule with no candidate is not listed. 50 strings in 12 locales. NOT walked in a browser: the renderers are driven in node and the wiring is pinned by source, but no Chromium click-through has been done (0.5.1 item 19, user-only).
